posts.title: On the rails: Festival bound…
posts.description: I’m heading across the Shropshire fields aboard a TfW 158 and happy to be heading to the Festival of Railway Modelling once more… 67016 propels into Ruabon, 21/11/2026. This annual trip is a great opportunity to see friends old and new, as well as an excuse, if one were needed to ride some more trains! Expect some sort of debrief tomorrow.
